storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/griddemand/, keyed by OBSERVATION day (period date, not fetch date) with event-identity dedup (respondent|period) across restarts; gz after 3 days (late hours keep arriving within the lag window)
written_by: server/gridDemand.ts archiveDemand (2h poll, 9 politeness-spaced calls/cycle, eager boot; key-gated on EIA_API_KEY — fredMacro/censusImports pattern)
source: EIA v2 API electricity/rto/region-data (EIA-930 hourly grid monitor) — free key, US government public domain. Shape verified live 2026-07-06 (DEMO_KEY): hourly demand (type D) per balancing authority, value as STRING MWh; bracketed params must be URL-encoded. API history to 2019. Scope v1: US48 + CISO/ERCO/MISO/PJM/NYIS/ISNE/SWPP/FPL
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor'

field_map.respondent|period — event-identity dedup: balancing-authority code + UTC hour; the same hour never re-archives
field_map.mwh: demand in megawatthours; missing/empty values are null, never zero

confidence_model: RAW official hourly demand. The industrial-activity-nowcast hypothesis stays gate-locked: gate 1 = US48 daily sum vs EIA's own Grid Monitor dashboard; gate 2 = degree-day-adjusted demand residual vs industrial-sector returns. Joins: CPC degree-days archive (live), power-plants layer, the Phase-2 grid layer.
cadence: hourly source (~1-2h publication lag); 2h poll with a 48h trailing window per respondent
